# Fit is a property of the pairing, not of the account. Half the profile…

`sales.mm.icp_definition.fit_is_a_joint_property` · v0.1.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **mental_model**

> Fit is a property of the pairing, not of the account. Half the profile is a statement about us.
 Change the price, the packaging or the implementation model and accounts move across the boundary without changing at all. A profile that has not been revisited since the last pricing change is stale by construction, and nobody thinks to revisit it because nothing about the market moved.
